notes.title: Update released, DLC Cybermagic and Escape from Meridian are now available
notes.notes:
The waiting is finally over. Huge game update is now released and both DLC are now available.

Free update contains numerous new improvements and fixes, new weapons, armors, implants, new unique upgrades for weapons and your equipment, allowing you to customize your character and arsenal even more than before.



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11613787/154ae957572390e4e2df53a34bb01f02927b4e79.png[/img]
This DLC unlocks a fourth playable character, Xandria aka Cyberwitch, who specializes in active ability uses. It also adds a lot of new combat abilities that can be used by other characters too, and new unique ability for each of the characters. You can also equip experimental psionic accelerator as a secondary weapon that can interface with your abilities and vastly improve their efficiency. Psi-acc can hold two additional abilities, meaning that you can enter the mission with two combat abilities activated in your Psi-acc and two additional of your choice for support. Burn your enemies with plasma fists or throw fireballs around, summon chain lighning or crush their heads from distance. Depending on your character, you will be able to squeeze heart of your enemy so hard he'll explode, cover the way to your hideout with energy mines, suck energy from nearby enemies to support your offensive abilities, or even summon a melee weapon from pure energy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11613787/364e9e5df674cfd08d31f1ff37efd377893e393f.png[/img]
This DLC is a story expansion that adds a new story arc with 10 story missions filled with new enemies, new features and some surprises. New enemies of common type, various new boss enemies requiring special tactics, and even some special skills for those you've been hunting before. DLC also adds new levels for other game modes, a new challenging game mode against special enemies, new difficulty level Insanity for those of you who feel that even Hell is too easy, unlockable special setting "INFECTION" for increased difficulty and extra challenge that can be toggled on older missions, and some other small goodies like two new available unique weapons and an unlockable ability to summon an auto-turret to the missions to help you with all those new zombies or just for slaughtering them where you prefer to hunt for loot.

notes.title: Dead Effect 2 Update BETA available
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11613787/553e306da8f9728122beb17b2ed96b2a1ccde856.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11613787/b01a0537f0e02d36e4aeb84dfb85d8c5a5b3e3dd.jpg[/img][/url]

We're finally getting close for a final release of the update and two DLCs we've been working on for so long. Although we've been testing and bug-hunting relentlessly, it's possible that there are still some issues remaining and we'd be grateful if few of you would like to try the update before it goes officially out. 

If you want to access the beta, open properties for Dead Effect 2 in your Steam library, open BETA´S tab and in the combo box select "testing external". 

This will update your version to our latest beta. All your saves from the previous version will be automatically backed-up (to files profile0.sav.updatebackup) in case you would want to revert to the standard version before we'll update it. You might want to back up your data manually before you switch to beta. You can find save files in AppData/LocalLow/Badfly Interactive/Dead Effect 2/ folder on your computer


Apart from the numerous old bug fixes and some small improvements, the update contains a lot of new content and some handy new features:

- New armor and implant sets and new upgrade modules for them with various unique boosts and bonuses, allowing you to customize your character even more.
- New weapon upgrades - you can now improve or modify your weapons with laser sights, penetrating ammo, scatter ammo and various new special boosts.
- New weapons, each in several variants. There are several small knives, throwing stars, 3 new big melee weapons, 6 secondary firearms including a small submachine gun, a new shotgun, and a new heavy rifle, all waiting to be added to your arsenal.
- A big pile of various unique weapons that can be unlocked by advancing in weapon training and finishing side tasks, bringing a total number of unique weapons to 25. New grenades, combo-weapons like a sniper-modified machine gun, shotgun revolver, powered melee weapon, shotgun modified to a powerful slug thrower...
- Abilities that unlock two new weapon slots - one for small melee/shurikens and one for additional general secondary, meaning that you can, for example, carry a sword and a pistol to the fight, or a knife and two pistols (and your main weapon of course)
- Dual wield ability, so you can hold that sword and pistol, or two pistols, or whatever you want, at once.
- Voice chat
- Weapons with holographic sights can be now customized - you can choose the size, color, and shape of the dot.
- Several new side tasks
- Few improvements in the store screens (you can now mark weapons as favorite and filter available weapons based on their type)

The update also contains necessary data for both upcoming DLCs. These are not yet available, but you can have a glimpse of some of the new stuff that will be available with CyberMagic DLC.


Info about upcoming DLCs:

CyberMagic DLC unlocks a fourth playable character, Xandria aka Cyberwitch, who specializes in active ability uses. It also adds a lot of new combat abilities that can be used by other characters too, and new unique ability for each of the characters. You can also equip experimental psionic accelerator as a secondary weapon that can interface with your abilities and improve their efficiency. Psi-acc can hold two additional abilities, meaning that you can enter the mission with two combat abilities activated in your Psi-acc and two additional of your choice for support.

Escape from Meridian DLC is a story expansion adding a new story arc with 10 story missions filled with new enemies, new features and some surprises. It also adds new levels for other game modes, a new game mode, special setting for increased difficulty, and some other small goodies like an unlockable ability to summon an auto-turret to the missions to help you with those new zombies.

notes.title: Dead Effect 2 Update Info
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11613787/553e306da8f9728122beb17b2ed96b2a1ccde856.jpg[/img]

After a long time in development, we are getting to the testing phase of all the new stuff that we're preparing for Dead Effect 2 and we thought it was high time to give you some info about what you can expect. There's a ton of small, not so small and big improvements, changes and new content waiting for you! 
A lot of those will be contained directly in the standard update, but some will require you to buy a DLC.

[b] The arsenal [/b] 
There are new implants and armor sets and pieces, often with unique powers, which you can further upgrade or customize with new special modules. You can look forward to a pile of new weapons, both melee, and firearms. New revolvers, pistols, submachine guns, knives, rifles… Luckily, you'll be able to bring more weapons on the missions after you upgrade your character!  
There are also some new unique 'ultimate' weapons waiting for you, but you'll have to earn those and it won't be easy.
There are new upgrades for most of the weapons that allow you to further customize your weapons. How about a shotgun modified to fire strong penetrating slugs? Or would you prefer a rate of fire over accuracy with rifles modified to quick burst fire? Is your character specialized in weapons and your suit energy is usually full? Most melee weapons can be now upgraded to use your power for additional damage and chance to stun your enemies! A hammer with a kinetic capacitor that charges with each swing until it releases all stored energy in one strong kinetic burst is a very nice tool to quickly disperse crowds of those annoying zombies!
And there are also several utility upgrades you can mount on some weapon,for example motion scanners and laser sights. 

[b] Cybermagic [/b] 
Meet Xandria, call sign Cyberwitch, our fourth playable character. She's no noob when it comes to standard weapons, but she specializes in combat implant use in the battle and brings a lot of new abilities, mostly direct damage dealing, to the table.  Equip her with a psionic accelerator that boosts ability efficiency and watch the world around you burn. 
Would you rather stick with your previous character? All original characters will be able to use most of the new abilities and combat tools, but Xandria is the most efficient with them. She's The Cyberwitch after all.

[b] Story Expansion - "Escape from Meridian" [/b] 
The fight for control over the ESS Meridian was a stalemate for a while. But now the balance of power is quickly shifting in a way that looks grimmer and grimmer every day…
You can look forward to a lot of story missions (about half in size when compared to the original game), full of new enemies… and these are not your standard variety of dumb space zombies. Whoever controls these new hordes is also teaching new nasty tricks to the standard enemies – but as the elite cyber soldiers you'll adapt and overcome these new threats.
Playing through the story expansion will also unlock some new options, including new special difficulty level “Infected” that will challenge you even when playing through the original missions. And you'll get access to new locations for standard game modes that may contain some interesting loot!

Cheers!

Your BFI Team

notes.title: THE GAME WITH NO LIMITS - TAUCETI UNKNOWN ORIGIN
notes.notes:
[img] http://deadeffect.com/!de/presentation/TC_01.jpg [/img]

It´s our pleasure to announce, that we are working on a brand new IP – TauCeti Unknown Origin, a real existing world with unlimited game opportunities.

This new action-packed coop sci-fi FPS game, is currently in development for PS4, XBOX ONE, PC, PC-VR and mobile platforms. TauCeti Unknown Origin offers an original and epic gameplay experience, set in an exciting and exotic space world.

https://youtu.be/IpsAILNvRs4

TauCeti Unknown Origin features a protagonist hero (you) living your worst nightmare. Your spaceship, the famed ESS Meridian (known from Dead effect 2) has gone haywire and crashed; luckily you managed to use the only working escape pod, which has sent you straight to TauCeti f, a strange and unknown land ready to be explored …  

The project aims at uniqueness, originality, and an epic exotic world of the game taking place in an existing planetary system around the TauCeti star.

KEY FEATURES
•	Cooperative game for up to 8 players
•	Solo, group and raid content
•	Class-based game 
•	PvE and PvP game modes
•	A strong story, following up of our previous games 
•	Open Word game with a lot of opportunities (to explore, harvest, craft, upgrade, build base)
•	RPG elements (ability, gear sets, a ton of upgradable weapons)


BadFly team

notes.title: Our Privacy Policy is correct. There is no "DATA MINING"...
notes.notes:
Dear community,

We would like to clarify that all information noted by our Privacy Policy do not violate any law or Steam´s Code of Conduct, indeed.

Please be aware we have never done "data mining" and never taken any advantage of gathering your data. The collecting of some data is a must by which we are ensuring the functionality of our services. Following that we would like to assure you - the claim about us doing it is a fraud.

Our Privacy Policy is general and refers to all our games available for all platforms. The collection of any personal or non-personal information applies to the functionality of our products/platforms, that use such a service – namely Dead Effect 1 and Dead Effect 2 for mobiles only. 

Note: We will never collect any information sent outside of the functionality of our Websites/Apps, including through emails or text messages.

This collection is the correct matter of enabling us to:
• provide you with any goods, services or functionality you have requested,
• respond to any inquiries you have made through our customer service features;

In any case, our purpose is not to abuse them!

Dead Effect 1 and Dead Effect 2 to for PC do not use these services, so there is no collecting of information.

Please be aware of the common use of this privacy policy, where is collecting of personal data used in the same way. This formal statement use even greater game developer companies for the same reason as the functionality of our services (etc. https://www.gameloft.com/en/privacy-notice).

Following that we would like to clarify we have never done, did, do or plan to do any “data mining”. As we look into this situation, such a hoax and fraud statement may cause the damage of our good reputation and trustful brand of our game developing. 

So to all loyal members of our great community:

WE ARE NOT DOING ANY DATA MINING 

If any of you suspect such a doing, please promptly contact us at support@badflyinteractive.com. 

All the evidence and information on this case can help us reach the fraud and intervene it through all available legal means.

BFI Team

notes.title: Beta Update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello players, 

we've made a patch that fixes some problems you're having, especially most of the crashes that sometimes happen, but we had to update the engine version we're using for it. As Unity updates sometimes break things that works, sometimes in a way that's not immediately visible (for example, we had a big performance hit with newer version we noticed only after some time and had to find a way to fix it, that's main reason why it took so long), we've decided to put the new patch out as a beta version first for people who're willing to help us test it.

To get the beta version you need to open the game properties in Steam and select "Betas" tab.

Change log:
- Updated engine version to unity 5.4.2p4 - should solve most of the crashes that happen
- Fixed disappering mjolnir hammer
- Fixed wrong missions selected for some side task (if your save contains any wrong task, running the save slot in the beta will automatically fix it and select valid side task)

BadFly dev.team

notes.title: New content update is live!
notes.notes:
Dear fans, 

we’d like to thank you for supporting us in 2016 and wish you all the best for 2017! Your support is a big pleasure and a huge motivation for us. Stay with us next year, as there’s so much to look forward to!
We’ve finished the development masive update which introduces a lot of new features and improvements for the game you all have been waiting.

Side tasks!
The biggest new feature in the update are the side tasks, available from the mission map. Hunt enemies, search for information and collect special parts to gain various rewards including special unique bonuses like discounts, damage bonuses or just really good equipment.
Weapon training! By solving progressively harder challenges with your weapons you can gain weapon training ranks that gives you special boosts to damage, accuracy and other weapon stats for all the weapons from the training category. Weapon training ranks are available for pistols, melee weapons, paralyzer, explosives, assault rifles, shotguns, sniper rifles, bows and heavy weapons.


New weapons!
The shop now offers new weapons - baseball bats for throwing enemies around, mighty hammers to smash them to pieces, also some swords and axes. 
If you prefer to shoot your way through: a new shotgun and a sniper rifle are waiting for you.


Ultimate weapons!
Have you reached level 20 and you think there's nothing more to do? After you gain enough ranks of the weapon training, you can start the quest line for the ultimate weapon to get the best possible weapon for your favorite category (and you will need it for the new difficulty level)! It will take along time, but the results will be worth it!
• BOOSTIG - the boosted STIG for the gunslingers who like the feel of the classics, but demand modern power!
• FORCESWORD - force field enhanced sword - chopping enemies to pieces was never so easy before!
• DEVIOUS DEVIANT - high rate of fire, huge magazine, very low recoil... you never need to pray when you spray with this gun!
• NUKED VENOM - do you like tearing enemies to pieces with your shotgun? The nuclear blasts from this shotgun can do that - and with style!
• TURBO SYNERGY - this sniper rifle shoots fast and hard. So hard that the penetrators can often kill two or more enemies in a row!
• EPIRUS ROCKETEER - arrows from this specialy designed bow can drill through several zombies at once.
• HEPLANNON - the heavy plasma cannon can burn even the biggest hordes or mightiest enemies to ash in a matter of seconds!
• IMPLODER - the implosion grenade sucks nearby enemies and compresses them to a bloody mush.

New equipment!
There are now some more armor suits and implants - including an epic CYWORG implant set that will give you several special abilities!

After you'll upgrade your base, you can order a custom made suit, just for you - and fill it with special upgrades! 

And there are also some other minor improvements and fixes including:
• Surround sound type can be now changed in the options (for cases where the game wrongly detects your hw)
• Film grain effect can be now disabled in options
• Rescaled leveling and story mission level requirements, allowing for faster play through the story
• Fixed some secret orbs (also set them to be visible even from far away) and missing credits in the

BadFly dev.team

notes.title: PERFORMANCE UPDATE is LIVE!
notes.notes:
CHANGED:
 - upgraded engine version to Unity 5.3.5
 - optimalized decals (performance gain in missions with more enemies)
 - a lot of minor memory optimalizations (may help with stuttering on edge cases)
 - ability pull enemy now stuns and damages the enemy
 - added surround sound support
 - discs from onyx disc launcher now has fewer bounces unless upgraded with special codex (and fixed the description of the codex)
 - added new outro on the end of the story campaign (there is problem with framerate drop it's known issue of Unity engine)

FIXED: 
 - disabled controller could still work in menus (causing constant movement to left in case of a wrong driver)
 - starting new game didn't reset enemy level in some cases
 - cut out name of the mission in the lobby window
 - last grenade throw always switched to primary weapon instead the last held weapon
 - HUD with absolute numbers wasn't updating correctly in the HUB after armor change
 - player basic HP now fixed at set value 
 - Drone summoning recharge spires even if it was already destroyed

notes.title: BETA IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://deadeffect2.com/assets/img/screenshots/DE2_PvP1.jpg[/img]

Dear community,

the day you’ve been waiting for is finally here. Today, we are proud to present you the full game in all its glory!

In the past few days, we’ve been working hard to bring you the complete content of the game, which means the level cap is now raised to the final 20. You’ll be able to go through the story from the beginning to the end without interruptions - on your own, or with your friends. 

One of the greatest additions though is the PvP multiplayer. In groups of up to 8 players, you can pick a side and fight against the opposing team in the most epic battles Meridian has ever seen.

Further additions include new maps for special mission modes, more and bigger weapons, or several visual health/stamina/power bar options. See below for the full list of all changes, fixes and additions. Enjoy the game, we will see you again next week for the full release!


WHAT WE ADDED:
- 7 new Story levels (level cap raised to 20)
- PvP multiplayer with “Deathmatch” and “Team Deathmatch” modes (for up to 8 players)
- New pack of weapons (shotgun, grenade launcher, sniper rifle, hammers and swords - there are more than 14 new weapons for you)
- New unique bossfight “Commander Decimus”  
- Knock back chance to melee weapons (strength implant increases chance)
- Visual info about stamina consumption for melee weapons
- New Infestation missions
- New Lonewolf missions
- New Survive and Biohazard missions


WHAT WE CHANGED:
- Improved AI of soldiers
- Lonewolf missions are now joinable in progress
- Melee weapons tuned - stamina consumption
- Changed (mostly increased) money reward for the hacking minigame
- Tuned damage bonus for weapon per rarity (bad weapons are a bit weaker, epic weapons are a bit better)
- Tuned GUI for shops and ability upgrades, making them more suitable for PC
- New character starting new game can pick any of the first three class abilities as the special ability
- Increased number of weapons in the shop, restock time was decreased to 20:00 mins
- Quick buy for weapon upgrades – Shift + click instantly buys upgrade without asking for confirmation
- Added sell price to reward info at the end of the mission
- It's possible to directly select the slot for the ability in the menu (two buttons "equip slot 1" and "equip slot 2" instead of just "equip")
- Options/GameSettings now allows changing type of the health/stamina/power bar: bars only, absolute numbers or percentage
- Tuned weapon drop rate probability
- Sprinting now disables motion scanner
- Weapon sounds improved
- Better balanced enemies, adjusted numbers and difficulty  
- New 3PV animations, gun-holding positions
- New weapon-holding 3PV animations for Jane 
- Polished aiming with weapons
- New gear sets and implants (Legendary and Mythical) 


WHAT WE FIXED:
 - Ammo dialogue on map will fire when player doesn't have enough ammo for the secondary weapon (it used to check only primary)
 - Wagners Inner Sanctum - fixed the rare problem with the blocked final minigame
 - Memory and speed optimizations
 - Player invincibility with open menu
 - Occasional player falling through the collision when setting trip mines and opening menu
 - Grenade dropping for player without grenades
 - Bleeding damage causing instant kill
 - Tablets slowing time in multiplayer
 - Strength implants no longer improve damage for the chainsaw
 - Wrong resolution (image quality) for some inventory items

As always - if you have any comments, questions, suggestions or reports, please, let us know in the forums. We will be working all week on testing and fixing, so any helping hand will be much appreciated!

Enjoy your Dead Effect 2 weekend :-)

Cheers,
BadFly Interactive team

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1 IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello community,

We are ever so sorry for having kept you waiting, but believe us - we were doing our best to be able to offer you lots of new content and as many fixes as possible. Without further ado, please welcome the new and improved Dead Effect 2! 

This update raises the level cap to number 14, which means 5 brand-new levels! There’s a lot of changes and additions in the coop, too (like joining mid-game, in-game chat, or continual playing), plus we’ve implemented fan-made Russian subtitles. Below is a list of all the tweaks, fixes and additions featured in the update – feast your eyes for a bit before you get back to slashing zombies, mutants and other baddies. Enjoy! 


WHAT’S FIXED:

CO-OP:
- Improved the online game browser (added info about difficulty, player count and progress of the game)
- Chat in the lobby (sending message after pressing the space bar)
- Wrong death screams for players 
- Synchronization of the codes for hacking minigames
- Fixed players spawning into each other
- Better balanced enemies – adjusted numbers and difficulty
- Fixed wrong synchronization of enemy numbers in Biohazard

CHARACTERS:
- 3PV animation tweaks – gun-holding positions, face expressions, shooting expressions
- Model skin tweaks

AI ENEMIES + NPCs:
- Skin tweaks
- AI soldier behaviour improved (they cover better, they are more accurate, they cooperate when moving between obstacles) 
- Delta soldiers with shotguns move in closer
- Increased health
- Ninjas have decreased health, but their attacks are more deadly

WEAPONS, IMPLANTS, GEAR:
- Aim position tweaks
- Codex compatibility for special implants (Wrestler's heart)
- Ammo refill before the mission start refills grenades too
- Sorting items in the gear and implant inventory

UI + CONTROLS:
- Mouse smoothing and acceleration - can be now disabled in Options (move the slider all the way to the left)
- Full screen glitches (unclickable text boxes, pads etc.)
- Changed the selection sound for Main menu and Options
- Wrong scale for the Mission Summary in some full-screen resolutions
- Minor GUI fixes

ACHIEVEMENTS:
- "I can haz no deathz" in coop
- Global achievements for fully upgrading weapons - require buying upgrades of legendary (golden) or mythical (purple) weapons. (It won't apply to weapons you have previously upgraded. Sorry!)
- Achievements for getting gear and implant sets
MISC BUGS + GLITCHES:
- “Technical assistance needed” mission – the damaged electric panel can be now hacked even in combat
- Fixed wrong secret orb count in some generic missions
- Fixed position of several message tablets that were inaccessible or hidden too well. 
- Fixed the credit position in "Showers don't work" mission
- Fixed the door locking in “Saved in a freezer” mission



WHAT’S ADDED:

GENERAL:
- 5 new story missions (level cap raised to 14)
- New environmental set in the new story missions 
- 3 new Survival and Biohazard missions
- 2 new generic missions with different quests
- New heavy weapons
- New unique bossfight “Sentinel of Death”
- Missions can be now started solo in the multiplayer mode and others can join you later.
- Russian translation (the language switch button is in Options)
- Added flashlight (default key "F")
- Grenade drops can be looted from killed enemies
- Possibility to quick-sell items by CTRL - clicking in the inventory on the listed item. Just be careful, once sold, Minikin will demand full price for the item!

CO-OP:
- In-game chat during the missions, in summary and shops - default key is 'K' (can be changed in Options)

notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE 1.01 IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for trying out Dead Effect 2 and giving us your feedback! We really appreciate it - it's helping us immensely to improve the game. The first hotfix update, originally announced for Friday, is finally here and here's what it's bringing:

GENERAL:
- massive optimization - especially for lower FX and light settings (High, Medium, Low)
- fixed the false level ups in the mission summaries
- fixed typos and other mistakes in texts
- removed references to crystals in texts

ANIMATION & GRAPHICS:
- ragdoll stabilization (especially with headshots - death animations adjusted)
- texture issues occurring after adjusting quality settings during the game - added a pop-up with warning (changes to the settings will show after restarting the game)
- added V-sync - can be turned on/off in the Settings
- DirectX 9 now running in exclusive mode

WEAPONS:
- fixed the stuck aiming (when reloading while opening a locker)
- fixed the grenades flying through closed doors
- fixed the weapon shop restock
- adjusted the mounted weapon sensitivity
- accelerated the weapon holster

SPECIAL ABILITIES:
- adjusted the radius - no more sticking to walls

CONTROLS AND UI:
- removed the Q & E quick turn
- fixed the mouse cursor lock/unlock in cut scenes and in medichamber
- adjusted the UI scale

CO-OP:
- lobby server made public by default
- fixed lagging issues
- fixed issues with joining servers
- fixed friend invite glitches

Hope this will help you enjoy our game even more! And please, keep sending us your feedback, it's really helpful and it enables us to speed up the implementation process.

Thank you, you are awesome!

Dead Effect 2 will be 15.99 USD in Early Access, with an initial release discount of 20 %, so you'll be able to get it for 12.70 USD.
We'll be submitting the build to Steam shortly, so we suppose the game will be live around 8-9 pm CET.

Cheers,
BadFly Interactive
